name: Wayfront
desc: Unify your process, automate steps, and help clients find what they need.

actions.name: create_client
actions.description: Creates a new client in your Wayfront workspace.

actions.name: update_client
actions.description: Updates a client in your Wayfront workspace. Only provided fields are changed.

actions.name: create_activity
actions.description: Creates a new activity log entry for a client in Wayfront.

actions.name: update_activity
actions.description: Updates an existing activity for a client in Wayfront.

actions.name: complete_activity
actions.description: Marks a scheduled activity as complete for a client in Wayfront.

actions.name: create_ticket
actions.description: Creates a new support ticket for a client in Wayfront.

actions.name: list_tickets
actions.description: Returns a list of tickets from your Wayfront workspace, sorted by most recent first.

actions.name: update_ticket
actions.description: Updates a ticket in Wayfront. Only the fields you provide will be changed.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: Returns a list of orders from your Wayfront workspace, sorted by most recent first.

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Creates a new order for a client in Wayfront.

actions.name: update_order
actions.description: Updates an order in Wayfront. Only the fields you provide will be changed.
